, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified Caterina Visconti’s husband as “Giovanni Visconti” based on a misleading search snippet instead of verifying the spouse on a reliable source; her actual husband was Gian Galeazzo Visconti, born in Pavia. This wrong identification led to researching the wrong person (the archbishop Giovanni Visconti) and concluding the incorrect birthplace (Milan).
